title: Do trained keyword-spotting models fit a Tiny Tapeout tile's 16-bit bias and 20-bit accumulator?
summary: All 96 retrained accel-kws models (70 and 120 inputs, hidden width 8–64, 2–8-bit weights, 3 seeds) on Speech Commands stay inside the streaming engine's limits: the largest layer-1 bias is 43% of the 16-bit limit and the largest accumulator 30% of the 20-bit limit, with no overflow on train or test clips. Accuracy through the tile's wrapping contract equals the integer reference on every model, and the 32 trained seed-0 models run bit-exact (class and cycles) through the Icarus RTL on 30 clips each. The accuracies accel-ttfit used are reproduced to within 0.010 for 3-, 4- and 8-bit weights. Stylised: one hidden layer, weak features, synthesis-only area.
